notes: Owner of entries: Branding. Owner of status=done: WellNest sync (/workspace/wellnest/sync-deck-queue.sh). Do not set status to done by hand.

Fields: category (one of the 5 exact names), order (1-5), name (Title Case), url (live deck URL, null until built), deckId (MUST equal the deck value the deck sends to MWSubmit), status: planned (not built) | ready (built, url set) | done (submitted).
When a deck is built: set url, set status to ready, keep deckId identical to its Submit deck value. Submit agent must be wellnest (submit_agent: wellnest) so it lands in inbox/wellnest.

Instant swap: after a successful Submit (real, not test) the deck should add its deckId to localStorage key wn-deck-done (JSON array; same origin webermanapps.github.io) and its Back link should go to https://webermanapps.github.io/wellnest-dashboard/?done=<deckId>.
Test submits (test:true) never count as done.
Optional fields (Oct 14 20:04): answered (int, cards answered so far; >0 shows Continue) and added (ISO time built; newest first).
